frequency_question: How often do announced large-scale secondary market intervention programs scale up to their target operational volumes or higher within 2.5 years of introduction?
membership_rule: Includes formalized, ongoing, recurring liquidity management or debt buyback/redistribution programs launched by G7 central banks or treasuries; excludes one-off emergency crisis interventions lasting less than six months.

cases.name: Bank of Japan JGB purchase program expansion
Federal Reserve QE1 implementation and scaling
ECB Public Sector Purchase Programme (PSPP) scaling
Bank of England gilt purchase market stabilization
Federal Reserve QT reduction of reinvestments (reverse operation)

coverage_note: 6 named cases covering major structured liquidity and debt management scaling events in G7 economies.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller or less transparent emerging market sovereign operations.
validity_reason: Sovereign debt operational scaling norms evolve slowly across institutional frameworks.
